annex_subject_peaceful_desc.en: Peaceful Integration is a [concept_diplomatic_action] that allows a country to peacefully annex a subject country.

annex_subject_peaceful_proposal_accepted.en: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] accepted our proposal for Peaceful Integration.
annex_subject_peaceful_proposal_accepted.es: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] ha aceptado nuestra propuesta de integración pacífica.

annex_subject_peaceful_proposal_declined.en: [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] declined our proposal for Peaceful Integration.

annex_subject_peaceful_proposal_notifica.en: [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] wishes to peacefully integrate with us.

covert_comms_disruption_action_pact_desc.es: Estamos interfiriendo las comunicaciones militares de [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], lo que degrada su eficacia en combate.

covert_counterintel_support_action_pact_.en: We are supporting the counterintelligence services of [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName].

covert_cultivate_assets_action_pact_desc.es: Estamos cultivando activos de inteligencia en [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName].

covert_destabilization_action_pact_desc.en: We are conducting a destabilization campaign against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], fueling political unrest and separatism.
covert_destabilization_action_pact_desc.es: Estamos llevando a cabo una campaña de desestabilización contra [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], alimentando el malestar político y el separatismo.

covert_financial_subversion_action_pact_.en: We are conducting covert financial subversion against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], destabilizing their financial markets.
covert_financial_subversion_action_pact_.es: Estamos llevando a cabo una subversión financiera encubierta contra [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], desestabilizando sus mercados financieros.

covert_ideological_subversion_action_pac.en: We are covertly promoting our ideology within [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], supporting sympathetic [Concept('concept_political_movement', 'political movements')].

covert_industrial_espionage_action_pact_.en: We are conducting industrial espionage against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], stealing their production secrets.
covert_industrial_espionage_action_pact_.es: Estamos llevando a cabo espionaje industrial contra [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], robando sus secretos de producción.

covert_influence_campaign_action_pact_de.en: We are conducting an influence campaign against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], weakening their resistance to our [concept_power_bloc] pressure.
covert_influence_campaign_action_pact_de.es: Estamos llevando a cabo una campaña de influencia contra [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], debilitando su resistencia a la presión de nuestro [concept_power_bloc|l].

covert_infrastructure_sabotage_action_pa.en: We are conducting covert sabotage operations against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], disrupting their [concept_infrastructure].
covert_infrastructure_sabotage_action_pa.es: Estamos llevando a cabo operaciones de sabotaje encubiertas contra [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], perturbando sus [concept_infrastructure|l].

covert_military_espionage_action_pact_de.en: We are conducting military espionage against [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName], gathering intelligence on their armed forces.

covert_secure_material_action_pact_desc.en: We are searching for loose nuclear material in [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName].
covert_secure_material_action_pact_desc.es: Estamos buscando material nuclear extraviado en [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName].

covert_space_espionage_action_pact_desc.en: We are stealing space programme designs from [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName].
covert_space_espionage_action_pact_desc.es: Estamos robando diseños del programa espacial de [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName].

decolonize_diplo_action_desc.en: Release a colonial territory as an independent nation.
decolonize_diplo_action_desc.es: Libera un territorio colonial como nación independiente.

diplomatic_alignment_action_notification.en: [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] has ended their alignment of [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]'s foreign policy with their own.
diplomatic_alignment_action_notification.es: [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] ha puesto fin al alineamiento de la política exterior de [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] con la suya.

diplomatic_alignment_action_notification.en: [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] has aligned [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName]'s foreign policy with their own.
diplomatic_alignment_action_notification.es: [INITIATOR_COUNTRY.GetName] ha alineado la política exterior de [TARGET_COUNTRY.GetName] con la suya.

diplomatic_alignment_desc.en: Diplomatic Alignment is a [concept_diplomatic_action] that allows a country to influence the foreign policy of another country.
diplomatic_alignment_desc.es: El alineamiento diplomático es una [concept_diplomatic_action|l] que permite a un país influir en la política exterior de otro país.

diplomatic_alignment_pact_desc.en: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName] is aligning its foreign policy with [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetFirstCountry.GetName].
diplomatic_alignment_pact_desc.es: [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetSecondCountry.GetName] está alineando su política exterior con la de [SCOPE.GetRootScope.GetDiplomaticPact.GetFirstCountry.GetName].

diplomatic_overture_modifier_desc.en: Our diplomats are pursuing negotiations and diplomatic engagement to resolve international tensions.
diplomatic_overture_modifier_desc.es: Nuestros diplomáticos llevan a cabo negociaciones y contactos diplomáticos para resolver las tensiones internacionales.

diplomatic_overture_rebuffed_modifier_de.en: Our diplomatic overture was rejected, resulting in a humiliating loss of face on the international stage.
diplomatic_overture_rebuffed_modifier_de.es: Nuestro acercamiento diplomático fue rechazado, lo que supuso una humillante pérdida de reputación en la escena internacional.

foreign_terror_diplomacy_modifier_desc.en: Quiet intelligence-sharing agreements help prevent future attacks while maintaining diplomatic channels.
foreign_terror_diplomacy_modifier_desc.es: Unos discretos acuerdos de intercambio de inteligencia ayudan a prevenir futuros atentados sin cerrar los canales diplomáticos.

humanitarian_aid_pact_desc.en: Gives money to the poor in another country, increasing influence and relations.
humanitarian_aid_pact_desc.es: Entrega dinero a los pobres de otro país, lo que aumenta la influencia y las relaciones.

identity_diplomatic_desc.en: This Identity is founded on [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle', 'principles')] of collective security, shared prosperity, and respect for international law.
identity_diplomatic_desc.es: Esta identidad se funda en [Concept('concept_power_bloc_principle', 'principios')] de seguridad colectiva, prosperidad compartida y respeto al derecho internacional.

intelligence_sharing_pact_desc.en: An agreement between two countries to share intelligence information.
intelligence_sharing_pact_desc.es: Un acuerdo entre dos países para compartir información de inteligencia.

intelligence_sharing_pact_effects_desc.en:
• +5% intelligence [concept_institution] effectiveness for both countries.
• +3 [concept_intelligence_capacity] for both.
• Once a year, the partner with the weaker covert defense is shielded by the stronger partner's intelligence, raising its Economic, Military and Ideological covert defense according to the gap between them.
• +10% intelligence institution costs for both.
• +300 [concept_treaty] leverage generation for both.
• Both countries gain 1 [concept_infamy] upon signing.
• Improves relations over time (max +60).
intelligence_sharing_pact_effects_desc.es:
• +5% de eficacia de la [concept_institution|l] de inteligencia para ambos países.
• +3 de [concept_intelligence_capacity|l] para ambos.
• Una vez al año, el socio con la defensa encubierta más débil queda protegido por la inteligencia del socio más fuerte, lo que eleva su defensa encubierta económica, militar e ideológica según la diferencia entre ambos.
• +10% de coste de la institución de inteligencia para ambos.
• +300 de generación de potestad del [concept_treaty|l] para ambos.
• Ambos países ganan 1 de [concept_infamy|l] al firmar.
• Mejora las relaciones con el tiempo (máx. +60).

principle_diplomacy_1_desc.en: The [concept_power_bloc] encourages diplomacy and peaceful resolution of conflicts.
principle_diplomacy_1_desc.es: El [concept_power_bloc|l] fomenta la diplomacia y la resolución pacífica de los conflictos.

principle_diplomacy_2_desc.en: The [concept_power_bloc] encourages diplomacy and peaceful resolution of conflicts.
principle_diplomacy_2_desc.es: El [concept_power_bloc|l] fomenta la diplomacia y la resolución pacífica de los conflictos.

principle_diplomacy_3_desc.en: The [concept_power_bloc] encourages diplomacy and peaceful resolution of conflicts.
principle_diplomacy_3_desc.es: El [concept_power_bloc|l] fomenta la diplomacia y la resolución pacífica de los conflictos.

principle_group_diplomacy_desc.en: The [concept_power_bloc] maintains a professional foreign service, projecting influence through bilateral diplomacy and peaceful resolution of conflicts.
principle_group_diplomacy_desc.es: El [concept_power_bloc|l] mantiene un servicio exterior profesional que proyecta influencia mediante la diplomacia bilateral y la resolución pacífica de los conflictos.

ruler_average_diplomat_desc.en: A ruler of unremarkable diplomatic skill. They manage foreign affairs competently but without particular distinction.
ruler_average_diplomat_desc.es: Un gobernante de habilidad diplomática poco destacable. Gestiona los asuntos exteriores con competencia, pero sin especial distinción.

ruler_exceptional_diplomat_desc.en: A diplomat of legendary skill whose charm and cunning elevate the nation's standing on the world stage. Foreign courts hang upon their every word.
ruler_exceptional_diplomat_desc.es: Un diplomático de habilidad legendaria cuyo encanto y astucia elevan la posición de la nación en el escenario mundial. Las cortes extranjeras están pendientes de cada una de sus palabras.

ruler_poor_diplomat_desc.en: A ruler whose social graces and diplomatic instincts leave much to be desired. Foreign envoys are unimpressed, and the nation's voice carries little weight abroad.
ruler_poor_diplomat_desc.es: Un gobernante cuyas dotes sociales e instintos diplomáticos dejan mucho que desear. Los enviados extranjeros no se dejan impresionar, y la voz de la nación pesa poco en el extranjero.

ruler_skilled_diplomat_desc.en: A ruler with natural charm and a talent for negotiation. The nation enjoys enhanced [concept_prestige] and a more favorable reputation in foreign courts.
ruler_skilled_diplomat_desc.es: Un gobernante con un encanto natural y talento para la negociación. La nación disfruta de mayor [concept_prestige|l] y de una reputación más favorable en las cortes extranjeras.

ruler_terrible_diplomat_desc.en: A ruler spectacularly unsuited for diplomacy. Foreign envoys leave insulted, alliances crumble, and the nation's reputation suffers at every turn.
ruler_terrible_diplomat_desc.es: Un gobernante espectacularmente inadecuado para la diplomacia. Los enviados extranjeros se marchan ofendidos, las alianzas se desmoronan y la reputación de la nación se resiente a cada paso.

ste_telepathic_diplomacy_desc.en: A direct mind-to-mind diplomatic channel has opened new possibilities for cooperation.
ste_telepathic_diplomacy_desc.es: Un canal diplomático directo de mente a mente ha abierto nuevas posibilidades de cooperación.

ste_telepathic_diplomacy_rejected_desc.en: Telepathic diplomacy was deemed too risky to pursue.
ste_telepathic_diplomacy_rejected_desc.es: Se consideró demasiado arriesgado recurrir a la diplomacia telepática.

trade_diplomacy_modifier_desc.es: Elegimos la diplomacia antes que las sanciones, lo que mantiene los flujos comerciales pero da la impresión de que no queremos enfrentarnos a nuestro rival.
